payload.name: Delivery Log
payload.description: What has happened to a recorded delivery after it was recorded (#680), append-only: the delivery's activity. An Address corrected row says its Delivery Address moved from Former Address to Address. Stock is not read from here: it is read off the delivery itself (lib/materialStock.js), so a correction moves it with its one write to the delivery.

fields.name: Delivery Log ID
fields.description: {Delivery ID}-{seq}, three digits, minted by lib/idSequence.server.js:generateChildId — the shape Delivery Item ID has, told apart by its table.

fields.name: Delivery
fields.description: The delivery this happened to. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: What happened: Address corrected (#680) — the delivery's address was corrected from Former Address to Address. Order attached (#277) — a delivery recorded with no order was attached to one. The screen's words (lib/deliveryLog.js).

fields.name: Address
fields.description: Where the delivery stands after the event: on an Address corrected row, the address it was corrected to. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Former Address
fields.description: On an Address corrected row, the address the delivery was corrected from. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Recorded By
fields.description: Who made the change. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Event At
fields.description: When it happened, UTC instant, *At convention.
